Tanya (AE): Heads-up — FinSecure wants a quick scoping call for a 4-week pilot next week. Primary ask: contract search + clause extraction across 5M docs. They flagged: long context, strict encryption, and a pricing cap.
Liam (SE): Ok — high level questions: expected QPS, avg doc size, and acceptance criteria?
Tanya (AE): They said ~200 QPS bursty, avg doc 12k tokens, but some docs ~80k tokens. Acceptance: clause search recall > 0.85, extract accuracy ~90% on test set, latency p95 < 700ms for search flow.
Noah (ML Eng): 80k tokens pushes us to either hybrid chunking or models with extended context. We should propose two tracks: (A) chunk+embedding+rerank with 32k or 64k model for rerank; (B) long-context model (>=100k) for single-pass.
Anita (Security): Customer requires KMS-managed keys, SOC2 + ISO27001, and they want the security questionnaire answered before kickoff. Also legal will push for data residency in eu-west1.
Liam (SE): For (A) we can do embeddings + sparse index -> top-200 -> rerank with Redwood-verified reranker model. Cost predictable, fits hosted/Dedicated. For (B) we can propose Private (VPC) + on-prem option but longer timeline and higher cost.
Tanya (AE): Price cap = $12k/month for pilot. Can we hit that on (A)?
Noah (ML Eng): Likely yes with embeddings + efficient reranker if we batch requests and use caching. Need to size embedding index memory. 5M docs -> embeddings store ~5M * 1536 dims ~ 30 GB (float32) but we can quantize to 8-bit.
Liam (SE): Quick sketch: ingest pipeline -> chunk 8k windows with 2k overlap -> embed chunks -> FAISS HNSW index -> candidate retrieve -> rerank (32k model). We'll measure recall on their eval set.
Tanya (AE): They also asked about tool calling for signature verification and a redaction hook for PII before sending out. Is that supported?
Noah (ML Eng): Yes — we can do function/tool calling. We should implement a pre-send step: local redaction microservice called via function call; signature verification can be an external call to their HSM-backed signer. Example call: 
```
POST /invoke_tool
{"tool":"redact", "text": "<doc>..."}
```
Liam (SE): For demo, we can wire a fake signer + redact service to show end-to-end. Production: customer will swap in their HSM/KMS.
Anita (Security): Need answers for questionnaire items: data-at-rest encryption, key rotation, separation of duties, audit log retention. I'll start filling the template — can someone drop asset IDs for our SOC2 attestation?
Liam (SE): I'll attach the SOC2 cert and a diagram of VPC flow.
ops-bot: deployment scheduled: sandbox-dedicated cluster reserved 2026-04-05T09:00Z (ticket #5643)
Tanya (AE): Timeline check: week1 ingest + eval setup, week2 run evals + refine chunking, week3 latency/scale tests, week4 review + acceptance. Is that realistic?
Noah (ML Eng): Yes but need early eval set from the customer by EOD Friday. Otherwise week1 slips.
Tanya (AE): I'll request the eval set and the security contact.
Anita (Security): Also ask them for required cipher suites and approved KMS vendors. Some enterprise legal teams insist on HSM attestation.
Liam (SE): Quick config snippet we can give them for the POC (hosted path):
```
model: rerank-32k-v2
embeddings: embed-lite-1536
batching:
  max_tokens: 2048
  timeout_ms: 50
routing:
  fallback: rerank-16k
```
Tanya (AE): If we do Dedicated reserved capacity, do we need a minimum commit? Pricing questions — finance will need to sign off if we apply credits to keep within $12k pilot cap.
Liam (SE): Dedicated monthly commit might exceed that. Suggest hosted pilot with quota limits + autoscale guardrails. We'll simulate production load in our sandbox to show feasibility.
Noah (ML Eng): Acceptance criteria proposal (to include in SOW):
- Functional: clause search recall >= 0.85 on their eval set; extraction F1 >= 0.90.
- Perf: search p95 <= 700ms; embed+retrieve p95 <= 500ms; end-to-end p95 <= 900ms under 200 QPS burst for typical doc sizes.
- Security: KMS integration validated; audit logs accessible; data residency confirmed.
Tanya (AE): I'll draft SOW with these metrics. Can someone own the SLO runbook?
Liam (SE): I'll own the runbook + demo playbook. Noah will own eval harness and metric collection. Anita will lead security questionnaire.
Anita (Security): I'll need the POC env details and retention period for logs. Also confirm whether customer can bring their own HSM keys into Redwood Private.
Noah (ML Eng): They can in Private mode; Hosted requires customer KMS integration via envelope encryption. We'll document both paths.
Tanya (AE): Next steps: I'll ask FinSecure for eval set + security contacts. Liam to prepare SOC2 + VPC diagram. Noah to prepare eval harness and sample metrics dashboard. Anita to start questionnaire. Everyone ok to review SOW draft by Thursday?
Liam (SE): Yep.
Noah (ML Eng): Yup.
Anita (Security): On it.
Tanya (AE): Great — thanks team :thumbsup: I'll post customer follow-up once I get the files.
